design_philosophy: Neo-Brutalism Soft & Energetic. A modern, vibrant university vibe that breaks the stiff corporate mold. It blends hard structural lines (1px/2px dark borders) with soft, energetic pastel/neon accents to feel approachable, youthful, and functional. Contrast is created via flat solid colors and distinct outlines, avoiding generic drop-shadows or gradients.

surface_strategies.cards: Flat solid surfaces with a crisp 2px border (#18181B). No soft drop shadows; instead, use hard offset shadows on hover (e.g., hover:shadow-[4px_4px_0px_#18181B] hover:-translate-y-1 transition-all).
surface_strategies.buttons: Pill-shaped or slightly rounded (rounded-lg) with 2px solid dark borders. High contrast text.
surface_strategies.inputs: Flat background with 2px borders. On focus, add a vibrant ring (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary focus:border-primary).
surface_strategies.headers: Solid background with a hard 1px/2px bottom border. Avoid glassmorphism for this specific Neo-Brutalism look to keep it grounded and legible.

layouts_and_grids.dashboard_metrics: MODE B (High Density Grid). Base grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4. Tight gap (gap-4). Every pixel utilized, identical widget heights.
layouts_and_grids.public_submission_form: MODE A (Tetris Grid). grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-8. Left side (col-span-5) features a sticky energetic campus image or 3D abstract shape; Right side (col-span-7) houses the bold form fields.
layouts_and_grids.club_directory: Responsive grid (grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6). Cards should be highly vibrant, using the club's brand_color as the top accent border or background tint.
layouts_and_grids.content_calendar: Standard CSS Grid for calendar days. Dense, information-rich, but color-coded by platform (e.g., Instagram=Pink, LinkedIn=Blue, Twitter=Black).

visual_enhancers.icons: lucide-react (Bold, 2px stroke width to match the Neo-Brutalist borders)
visual_enhancers.motion: Framer Motion. Use spring physics for micro-interactions (stiffness: 400, damping: 25). Staggered entrances for list items and directory cards.
visual_enhancers.empty_states: Playful and large. Use bold oversized typography and abstract shapes rather than sad generic illustrations.

components.navigation: Side navigation for admins (dense, icon+label, sharp hover states). Top horizontal navigation for public/student view with a prominent 'Submit Post' CTA.
components.tables: Shadcn UI table, customized to remove standard subtle gray borders. Use 1px solid black borders, alternating row colors (white/off-white) and vibrant badges for statuses (Pending=Yellow, Approved=Green, Rejected=Red).
components.modals: Slide-over (Sheet) for Admin Review Queue items to allow side-by-side reading of the request while maintaining context of the list.

public_hero_image.description: Active students walking together. Use on the public submission landing page.

campus_building.description: Tall university building. Use as a background accent or auth page banner.

accessibility.contrast: Enforce strict contrast ratios. Black text on vibrant colors is required.
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements must have focus-visible outlines with a 2px offset.
accessibility.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion media query by disabling hover translations.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use strict Neo-Brutalist soft styling: Elements should have border-2 border-black rounded-lg shadow-none. On hover, apply shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_rgba(0,0,0,1)] and -translate-y-1.
Do NOT use standard soft SaaS drop shadows (e.g., shadow-md, shadow-lg). Replace them with hard solid color offset shadows.
Do NOT center align text globally. Align left for readability.
Include 'data-testid' attributes on all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, links).
Use Recharts for the Admin Dashboard (submissions/posts breakdown) and style the charts with solid, vibrant colors and sharp borders, avoiding smooth gradients.
For the public submission form, build a wizard/multi-step layout if necessary, keeping it visually engaging with large click targets.
